papers.title: Properties and Bayesian fitting of restricted Boltzmann machines
papers.abstract: A restricted Boltzmann machine (RBM) is an undirected graphical model constructed for discrete or continuous random variables, with two layers, one hidden and one visible, and no conditional dependency within a layer. In recent years, RBMs have risen to prominence due to their connection to deep learning. By treating a hidden layer of one RBM as the visible layer in a second RBM, a deep architecture can be created. RBMs are thought to thereby have the ability to encode very complex and rich structures in data, making them attractive for supervised learning. However, the generative behavior of RBMs is largely unexplored and typical fitting methodology does not easily allow for uncertainty quantification in addition to point estimates. In this paper, we discuss the relationship between RBM parameter specification in the binary case and model properties such as degeneracy, instability and uninterpretability. We also describe the associated difficulties that can arise with likelihood-based inference and further discuss the potential Bayes fitting of such (highly flexible) models, especially as Gibbs sampling (quasi-Bayes) methods are often advocated for the RBM model structure.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该文章关于受限玻尔兹曼机的贝叶斯拟合，与有限元代理建模无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper studies theoretical properties and Bayesian inference of RBMs with no application to FEA surrogate modeling, no constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification for engineering design, and no biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究受限玻尔兹曼机的生成性质与贝叶斯拟合。
summary_zh.method: 分析二元RBM的参数与模型退化、不稳定性关系，讨论贝叶斯方法。
summary_zh.result: 揭示了RBM拟合中的不稳定性问题，提出似然推断困难。

summary_en.motivation: To explore the generative behavior and Bayesian fitting of restricted Boltzmann machines.
summary_en.method: Relationship between parameter specification and model degeneracy is discussed, and Bayesian inference using Gibbs sampling is considered.
summary_en.result: Likelihood-based inference for RBMs can be unstable and uninterpretable.

papers.title: Bond strengths of porcelain to cobalt-chromium alloys made by casting, milling, and selective laser melting
papers.first_author_affiliation: Resident, Department of Stomatology, Jieyang People's Hospital, Jieyang, PR China

corresponding_authors.name: Jiantao Ye
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Assistant Professor and Director, Department of Prosthodontics, Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hospital, Sun Yat-sen University, Guangzhou, PR China. Electronic address: dutaoye@163.com

llm.relevance_to_user: 本研究涉及钴铬合金的增材制造及其与瓷的结合强度，但未涉及植入物应力屏蔽、疲劳或骨整合。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on dental porcelain bonding to Co-Cr alloys, not on hip implant stress shielding, osseointegration, or fatigue behavior.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较不同制造方法对钴铬合金与瓷结合强度的影响。
summary_zh.method: 采用铸造、铣削和选择性激光熔化三种工艺制备钴铬合金试样，进行瓷结合强度测试。
summary_zh.result: 选择性激光熔化试样的瓷结合强度与铸造和铣削试样相当或更优。
summary_zh.validation: 通过标准拉伸-剪切测试验证结合强度。

summary_en.motivation: To compare the porcelain bond strength of cobalt-chromium alloys fabricated by casting, milling, and selective laser melting for dental applications.
summary_en.method: Specimens were fabricated using three methods (casting, milling, SLM) and subjected to a standardized porcelain bond strength test.
summary_en.result: SLM-fabricated specimens achieved comparable or superior bond strength to those made by casting and milling.
summary_en.validation: Bond strength was validated via tensile-shear testing following ISO standards.

llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on theoretical properties of RBMs for unsupervised learning, with no application to surrogate modeling, FEA, or biomechanical design.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索受限玻尔兹曼机在生成建模中的理论性质与潜在问题。
summary_zh.method: 理论分析二进制RBM的参数规范与模型退化、不稳定性。
summary_zh.result: 指出RBM在似然推断和不确定性量化方面的困难。
summary_zh.validation: 无实验验证，纯理论讨论。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the theoretical properties and potential pitfalls of restricted Boltzmann machines in generative modeling.
summary_en.method: Theoretical analysis of binary RBM parameter specification and its relation to degeneracy, instability, and uninterpretability.
summary_en.result: Identifies difficulties in likelihood-based inference and uncertainty quantification for RBMs.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation; purely theoretical discussion.

papers.title: Pengaruh Tugas Rumah dalam Model Pembelajaran Aktif Tipe QuiZ Team (AL TQT)Terhadap Hasil Belajar Siswa Kelas X SMA Negeri 1 Bengo (Studi Materi Pokok Ikatan Kimia)
papers.abstract: ABSTRAK Penelitian eksperimen semu ini bertujuan untuk mengetahui pengaruh pemberian tugas rumah dalam model pembelajaran active learning type quiz team terhadap hasil belajar siswa kelas X SMAN 1 Bengo. Variabel bebas dalam penelitian ini adalah pembelajaran active learning type quiz team dengan pemberian tugas rumah (resume) di kelas eksperimen dan model pembelajaran active learning type quiz teamtanpa pemberian tugas (resume) di kelas kontrol, serta variabel terikatnya adalah hasil belajar siswa pada materi pokok ikatan kimia. Populasi penelitian ini adalah siswa kelas X SMAN 1Bengo yang berjumlah 3 kelas, sedangkan Sampel penelitian yang digunakan 2 kelas, dipilih menggunakan teknik random atau mengambil 2 kelas secara acak yaitu kelas X MIA 1 sebagai kelas eksperimen dengan jumlah siswa 29 orang dan kelas X MIA 2 sebagai kelas kontrol dengan jumlah siswa 29 orang.Data hasil penelitian diperoleh dengan memberikan tes hasil belajar pada materi ikatan kimia berupa post-test yang terdiri dari 25 butir soal pilihan ganda diakhir pertemuan. Teknik analisis data menggunakan analisis statistik deskriptif dan inferensialdengan bantuan SPSS V22. Pengujian hipotesis yang dilakukan dengan uji t pada hasil belajar siswa menghasilkan pvalue< 0,05 yaitu 0,000. Hasil uji-t membuktikan bahwa pemberian tugas rumah dalam model pembelajaran active mpada materi ikatan kimia. Kata Kunci : Tugas rumah, active learning, quiz team, hasil belajar, ikatan kimia ABSTRACT This study was a quasi-experimental research aimed to determine the effect of Homework In Active Learning Model Type Quiz Team In The Result Of Student Learning Class X SMAN 1 Bengo. The independent variablein this study is a active learning type of quiz team by giving homework in class experiments and models active learning of type quiz team without giving tasks in the control class, as well as the dependent variable is the learning achievement of students in the subject matter of chemical bonds. The population of this research is class X of SMAN 1 Bengo, amounting to 3 classes, the study sample consisted of two classes of class XMIA1 as a experiment class with the number of students 29 people and students of class XMIA2 as a control class with the number of 29 people. The research data obtained by giving test results to learn the material in the form of chemical bonding that the post-test consisted of 25 multiple-choice items at the end of the meeting. Data analysis used descriptive and inferential statistic by SPSS V22. Hypothesis test by t test of student’s achievement shown pvalue< 0,05 was 0.000. T-test results prove that the giving homework active learning model type quiz team has positive influence onthe results of class X student of SMAN1Bengo studies on chemical bonding material. Keyword : Homework, active learning, quiz team, achievement, chemical bonding

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究化学教育中的作业效果，与有限元代理建模、植入物设计或生物力学完全无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is about chemistry education pedagogy, with no FEA, surrogate modeling, uncertainty quantification, or biomedical/mechanical design context.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究化学教育中家庭作业对学习效果的影响
summary_zh.method: 采用准实验设计，实验组布置家庭作业，对照组不布置
summary_zh.result: 家庭作业对化学学习有积极影响
summary_zh.validation: 通过后测和t检验验证假设

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of homework on student learning outcomes in chemistry education.
summary_en.method: A quasi-experimental design was used with an experimental group receiving homework and a control group without.
summary_en.result: Homework had a positive effect on student achievement in chemical bonding.
summary_en.validation: Hypothesis testing via t-test on post-test scores.
